question_text: Under RA 6713 (Code of Conduct), what document must public officials disclose their assets, liabilities, and business interests?

options.text: SALN (Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth)

hint_ladder.title: Orient
hint_ladder.text: Alamin: RA 6713 requires officials to disclose all wealth. Isipin mo, para kang nagbubukas ng resibo sa publiko.

hint_ladder.title: Rule
hint_ladder.text: Ang tawag sa dokumentong iyan ay SALN — Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth. Ito ang legal na declaration ng lahat ng ari-arian, utang,...

hint_ladder.title: Apply
hint_ladder.text: Ngayon, tingnan ang choices: ITR ay para lang sa buwis, Bank Statement galing sa banko, Audit Report mula sa COA. Tanging SALN ang mismong idine-de...

hint_ladder.title: Nearly Give Away
hint_ladder.text: Ito na: Ang sagot ay 'SALN'—kilala sa balita tuwing may isyu ng corruption. Hanapin ang acronym na ito at surebol na sagot.

A.text: You might have chosen A because the Income Tax Return also lists financial info, but it's filed with BIR for taxes, not for public transp...

B.text: Correct. RA 6713 requires the SALN to publicly disclose all assets, liabilities, and business interests.

C.text: You might have chosen C because a bank statement shows money, but it lacks liabilities and isn't a sworn filing.

D.text: You might have chosen D because an audit report checks finances, but it's done by auditors, not a personal declaration of wealth.

deconstruct_text:
Para bang si Kapitan Mike ng Brgy. San Jose, may sari-sari store, tricycle, at utang sa 5-6. Under RA 6713, required siyang mag-declare ng lahat ng yan sa isang dokumento. Hindi pwede ang ITR o bank statement—SALN ang tawag dito.

Ang SALN ay Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth. Parang financial selfie—pinapakita lahat ng ari-arian, utang, at kung magkano talaga ang net worth mo. Dito malalaman kung biglang yaman ang opisyal.

next_time_rule: Whenever you see RA 6713 and words like 'assets,' 'liabilities,' or 'business interests,' think SALN—it's the transparency document for public officials.
